items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: And Roy Barkey's the only guy that's ever been in the house that was able to play the metal, so it sounded like anything.

ctx.x: Now how can you have a tune that simple?

Uh, uh, well you can, uh, it's impossible. I can't play it on the piano, so it sounds like anything at all. And we used to try it on, on awful good pianists all the time. And Roy Barkey's the only guy that's ever been in the house that was able to play the metal, so it sounded like anything. It's a tricky sort of thing. Getting back to the, to the, to chords. You're, if you listen to Negroes singing in the south, I, I heard them not in New Orleans, but I heard them in the, uh, in the fields, or in Florida when I…
So, so it's, it's, it's, it's the treatment of the third that, that might have, uh.
